Comments, deletion, reporting and hiding are implemented. `bunx guren gate` passes all six stages, including `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (25 tests, 0 failures).

## Things you might not expect

- **Cascade is done by hand.** A SQLite connection in this app opens with foreign keys off (I probed it: `PRAGMA foreign_keys` is 0 until `resetDatabase()` runs). The schema declares `ON DELETE CASCADE`, but deleting a post or comment removes its comments and reports explicitly, in a transaction. The tests turn foreign keys off so they exercise that path.
- **Comment bodies are trimmed before the length check**, as post titles are. A whitespace-only body is rejected with 422.
- **Hiding is derived, not stored.** The post page counts report rows each time it is built. It loads every report row for the post's comments to do so, which is fine now but should become a grouped count if reports grow large.
- **Nothing un-hides a comment.** Three accounts acting together can hide any comment until review tooling exists.
- **Report is sent by `fetch`, not an Inertia link**, because a 204 with no body is not an Inertia response. The page then reloads the comments in case that report was the third.
- **`created_at` has a database-side default** on both new tables, so review tooling can insert rows without the ORM.
- **I added an ADR** you did not ask for, recording the threshold and the hand-deletion decision.

## Summary

I added the `comments` and `comment_reports` tables to `db/schema.ts` with migration `db/migrations/20260929163126_add_comments`, the latter unique on (`comment_id`, `user_id`). The new models are `app/Models/Comment.ts` (with `visibleOn` and `purge`) and `app/Models/CommentReport.ts` (with the idempotent `record`). `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts` is registered in `app/Providers/AuthorizationProvider.ts`, alongside `app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts` and `app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts`. `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts` provides `store`, `destroy` and `report`, wired in `routes/web.ts` behind the `auth` middleware as `comments.store`, `comments.destroy` and `comments.report`. `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` now passes `comments` to `posts/Show` and purges a post's comments on delete. `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` renders the list, the comment box, and the Delete and Report controls. The `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests are regenerated, the tests are in `tests/CommentController.test.ts`, and the ADR is `docs/adr/0002-hide-comments-at-three-reports.md`.
